stock.description: Build King Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company primarily engaged in civil engineering projects across the People's Republic of China and the Middle East. Its core construction activities involve developing institutional and educational facilities, residential complexes, and commercial buildings. Additionally, the company provides fitting-out, improvement, and alteration services for existing structures. The company's diverse project portfolio further includes environmental initiatives, foundation works, and a wide array of general civil engineering tasks, such as airport infrastructure, drainage and water systems, landscaping, site formation, sports grounds and parks, and road and bridge construction. It also undertakes marine works, encompassing general marine construction and submarine pipeline installation, as well as railway infrastructure and track projects, structural steel works, and tunnel construction. Beyond these, Build King Holdings offers services in general construction, marine engineering and transportation, sewage treatment, secretarial and nominee services, electrical and mechanical engineering, and marine construction contracting. The company also supplies steam fuel. Founded in 1980, Build King Holdings Limited is based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Top Horizon Holdings Limited.
